statusSemantics.supported: Current jedit behavior has executable or inspectable proof.
statusSemantics.partial: Current jedit behavior covers part of Vim's expected behavior but needs more grammar, target, or witness work.
statusSemantics.unsupported: Current jedit behavior should not be claimed as available.
statusSemantics.causally-enhanced: The target intentionally exceeds Vim baseline and remains planned until executable proof lands.

echoBoundary: Echo remains generic; Vim keys, motions, text objects, registers, macros, buffers, and editor names stay in jedit.
graftBoundary: Graft may provide structural readings, but it is not editable text authority.

items.targetParity: Move by character and screen line in Normal and operator-pending contexts.
items.currentJedit: Basic cursor movement exists, but it is not yet a first-class motion algebra.
items.proofGap: Needs ResolvedMotion facts with basis and obstruction posture.
items.causalOpportunity: Non-mutating navigation can emit optional navigation facts without mutating Echo history.
items.echoBoundary: Echo receives no admission for pure cursor movement.

items.targetParity: Move to line start, first non-blank, and line end.
items.currentJedit: Line-shaped navigation exists in the UI path.
items.proofGap: Needs byte/grapheme policy facts and operator-pending range proof.
items.causalOpportunity: Resolved ranges can preserve reading basis and affinity.
items.echoBoundary: Echo sees only later edit intents that consume these ranges.

items.targetParity: Move to file start and file end, with count-aware line targeting.
items.currentJedit: Goto-shaped behavior exists, but full Vim count semantics are not proven.
items.proofGap: Needs bounded-reading obstruction and full-reading expansion posture.
items.causalOpportunity: File-scope commands can record the reading aperture used.
items.echoBoundary: Echo remains unaware of cursor or viewport nouns.

items.targetParity: Resolve word and WORD movement with counts and operator ranges.
items.currentJedit: Word-shaped movement exists for some focused behavior.
items.proofGap: Needs table-driven tokenization policy for words, WORDs, and punctuation.
items.causalOpportunity: Word ranges can carry token policy evidence in JSON witnesses.
items.echoBoundary: Echo receives only the compiled mutation when a motion is paired with an operator.

items.targetParity: Move by forward/backward search and repeat search direction.
items.currentJedit: Search motion parity is not complete.
items.proofGap: Needs search history, match identity, basis facts, and UI command integration.
items.causalOpportunity: Search results can become stable match ids for later range commands.
items.echoBoundary: Echo does not parse patterns; jedit submits only chosen edit intents.

items.targetParity: Jump to matching delimiter, tag, or language pair where supported.
items.currentJedit: Delimiter matching is not parity-complete.
items.proofGap: Planned via text fallback first, then optional Graft structural readings.
items.causalOpportunity: The match provider and pair identity can be recorded beside the resolved range.
items.echoBoundary: Echo remains generic; Graft and jedit own structure facts.

items.targetParity: Move by paragraph and section boundaries.
items.currentJedit: Paragraph movement resolves against blank-line boundaries; section movement remains unsupported.
items.proofGap: Needs structural-section fixture tables and section motion resolver support.
items.causalOpportunity: Section movement can degrade honestly when structural providers are absent.
items.echoBoundary: Echo receives no structural nouns.

items.targetParity: Compile delete, change, and yank over motions and text objects.
items.currentJedit: Pending operators exist for delete, change, and yank in focused paths.
items.proofGap: Needs shared operator compiler and register provenance.
items.causalOpportunity: Mutating operators can produce receipt and reading facts; yank stays non-mutating.
items.echoBoundary: Echo admits only mutation intents, never raw Vim operators.

items.targetParity: Put register material after or before the target position.
items.currentJedit: Register-backed put parity is not complete.
items.proofGap: Needs register material shape and insertion target semantics.
items.causalOpportunity: Put can preserve source register provenance in the emitted edit group.
items.echoBoundary: Echo sees inserted material and receipt facts, not register names.

items.targetParity: Replace one character or stream replacement text in Replace mode.
items.currentJedit: Replace-mode parity is not complete.
items.proofGap: Needs grapheme/byte policy and repeated replacement intent.
items.causalOpportunity: Replacement streams can be grouped as one causal edit.
items.echoBoundary: Echo admits explicit replace ranges only.

items.targetParity: Indent, outdent, reindent, and format resolved line ranges.
items.currentJedit: Formatter-backed Vim operators are not production-complete.
items.proofGap: Needs provider boundary, linewise transform facts, and obstruction posture.
items.causalOpportunity: Broad formatting can preview as a causal strand before admission.
items.echoBoundary: Echo does not run formatters; jedit submits admitted text transforms.

items.targetParity: Lowercase, uppercase, or toggle case over resolved targets.
items.currentJedit: Case-transform operators are not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs deterministic transform tables and locale posture.
items.causalOpportunity: Case transforms can produce compact before/after digests.
items.echoBoundary: Echo admits the final transform intent without knowing Vim syntax.

items.targetParity: Join lines with or without Vim's whitespace normalization.
items.currentJedit: Join operators are not parity-complete.
items.proofGap: Needs linewise target resolution and whitespace policy fixtures.
items.causalOpportunity: Join can report exact affected line ids and resulting digest.
items.echoBoundary: Echo receives a text replacement intent.

items.targetParity: Apply external filters or ex range commands over resolved ranges.
items.currentJedit: Host filter and range-command operators are not implemented.
items.proofGap: Planned as explicit host-boundary work with strand preview for broad edits.
items.causalOpportunity: External effects can be represented as reviewed strands before admission.
items.echoBoundary: Echo never executes host commands; jedit owns the adapter boundary.

items.targetParity: Read to resolve a target and write the resulting mutation without basis drift.
items.currentJedit: Text-object operators are not implemented as atomic semantic transactions.
items.proofGap: Needs a basis-bound operation that resolves target and mutation together or obstructs stale basis.
items.causalOpportunity: Read, resolution, register update, mutation, and receipt can share one causal boundary.
items.echoBoundary: Echo owns transaction atomicity and stale-basis obstruction; jedit owns Vim semantics.

items.targetParity: Keep register writes and text mutations consistent for each semantic command.
items.currentJedit: Full register provenance and atomic register/text grouping are not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs register state with source basis, material digest, shape, receipt, and obstruction policy.
items.causalOpportunity: Registers can be app-owned projections backed by Echo retained evidence.
items.echoBoundary: Echo does not learn register names; it stores text evidence and receipts.

items.targetParity: Replay macros as causal scripts with explicit obstruction instead of hidden key timing.
items.currentJedit: Macro recording and replay are not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs semantic macro entries, bounded raw insert spans, edit-group posture, and replay report.
items.causalOpportunity: Macro replay can emit applied count, receipt ids, final reading, and obstructed entry.
items.echoBoundary: Echo admits the resulting text operations; jedit owns macro language and grouping.

items.targetParity: Undo and redo become explicit inverse causal inputs, not hidden snapshot rollback.
items.currentJedit: Production undo and redo remain unsupported until modeled as causal input.
items.proofGap: Needs inverse intent derivation from receipts and a visible unsupported posture until then.
items.causalOpportunity: Original edit, undo, and redo can all remain explainable causal history.
items.echoBoundary: Echo owns receipts and inverse admission; jedit owns Vim undo command policy.

items.targetParity: Resolve inner and around word or WORD objects.
items.currentJedit: Text-object grammar is not complete.
items.proofGap: Needs resolver spine plus tokenization fixtures.
items.causalOpportunity: Token ranges can include basis and tokenizer evidence.
items.echoBoundary: Echo receives only the compiled edit range.

items.targetParity: Resolve sentence and paragraph text objects.
items.currentJedit: Sentence and paragraph objects are not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs boundary fixture tables and inclusive around policy.
items.causalOpportunity: Paragraph edits can preview as broad causal changes.
items.echoBoundary: Echo stays unaware of sentence or paragraph nouns.

items.targetParity: Resolve inner and around quote objects.
items.currentJedit: Quote text objects such as ci" are target workflows, not complete runtime truth.
items.proofGap: Needs delimiter-pair evidence and escape handling.
items.causalOpportunity: Quote-pair identity can support transformed dot repeat.
items.echoBoundary: Echo admits only the final text replacement.

items.targetParity: Resolve balanced pair objects for parentheses, brackets, and braces.
items.currentJedit: Balanced pair text objects are not parity-complete.
items.proofGap: Needs nesting, imbalance, and cursor-position fixture tables.
items.causalOpportunity: Balanced ranges can degrade honestly when malformed.
items.echoBoundary: Echo does not own delimiter matching.

items.targetParity: Resolve tag-like structural objects when language structure is available.
items.currentJedit: Tag objects are not implemented.
items.proofGap: Planned through optional Graft structure provider.
items.causalOpportunity: Provider identity and structural node ids can be included in witnesses.
items.echoBoundary: Echo never stores tag semantics.

items.targetParity: Resolve functions and classes as structural objects.
items.currentJedit: Function and class text objects are not implemented.
items.proofGap: Planned through optional Graft structure provider with unavailable lower mode.
items.causalOpportunity: Structural object ids can support history-aware edits.
items.echoBoundary: Echo receives no language-specific nouns.

items.targetParity: Resolve comments and indentation blocks.
items.currentJedit: Comment and indentation text objects are not implemented.
items.proofGap: Planned as text fallback plus optional structural provider.
items.causalOpportunity: Indent scopes can become causally stable range apertures.
items.echoBoundary: Echo remains generic.

items.targetParity: Select charwise ranges and apply operators.
items.currentJedit: Visual charwise mode is not production-complete.
items.proofGap: Needs explicit range aperture state and operator compilation.
items.causalOpportunity: Selection can be a reading-basis range aperture.
items.echoBoundary: Echo sees only admitted mutation intents.

items.targetParity: Select linewise ranges and apply operators.
items.currentJedit: Visual linewise mode is not production-complete.
items.proofGap: Needs linewise target facts and mode exits.
items.causalOpportunity: Linewise range sets can be emitted as witness facts.
items.echoBoundary: Echo does not own selection state.

items.targetParity: Select rectangular block ranges and apply operators.
items.currentJedit: Blockwise visual mode is not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs block range-set representation and lower-mode posture.
items.causalOpportunity: Block edits can be grouped as one causal range-set intent.
items.echoBoundary: Echo admits the resulting range-set operation.

items.targetParity: Swap the active end of a visual selection.
items.currentJedit: Visual anchor swapping is not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs selection anchor and focus state.
items.causalOpportunity: Anchor facts can explain selection changes without pixels.
items.echoBoundary: Echo is not involved.

items.targetParity: Track unnamed, numbered, and small-delete registers.
items.currentJedit: Yank/delete flows exist, but full register provenance is not complete.
items.proofGap: Needs app-owned register state with content digest and source basis.
items.causalOpportunity: Register material can cite source basis and receipt provenance.
items.echoBoundary: Echo does not store register names.

items.targetParity: Read and write named registers.
items.currentJedit: Named registers are not parity-complete.
items.proofGap: Needs register prefix grammar and storage.
items.causalOpportunity: Named register facts can be redacted for agents.
items.echoBoundary: Echo sees only text material in admitted operations.

items.targetParity: Append to named registers.
items.currentJedit: Append registers are not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs append semantics and linewise/charwise preservation.
items.causalOpportunity: Append history can cite multiple source ranges.
items.echoBoundary: Echo remains generic.

items.targetParity: Discard operator output without changing unnamed register.
items.currentJedit: Black-hole register is not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs register write suppression proof.
items.causalOpportunity: Discard can still emit non-secret operation facts.
items.echoBoundary: Echo sees only the text mutation, not discarded register policy.

items.targetParity: Bridge optional system clipboard registers.
items.currentJedit: System clipboard register posture is not complete.
items.proofGap: Needs host clipboard adapter and unavailable posture.
items.causalOpportunity: Clipboard import/export can carry redacted provenance.
items.echoBoundary: Echo never talks to the host clipboard.

items.targetParity: Expression register remains unsupported until evaluator policy exists.
items.currentJedit: Expression register is not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs explicit non-goal or evaluator design before implementation.
items.causalOpportunity: Unsupported posture can prevent fake expression support.
items.echoBoundary: Echo does not evaluate expressions.

items.targetParity: Capture the last meaningful edit as semantic repeat identity.
items.currentJedit: Dot repeat is not complete as semantic intent.
items.proofGap: Planned identity must exclude raw timing and diagnostic prose.
items.causalOpportunity: Repeat can store command intent, basis, target kind, and inserted material digest.
items.echoBoundary: Echo replays admitted jedit intents, not raw key delays.

items.targetParity: Replay prior edit intent against the current reading basis.
items.currentJedit: Transformed dot repeat is not implemented.
items.proofGap: Planned resolver must obstruct when the target cannot be transformed safely.
items.causalOpportunity: This is a primary causal movement: same intent, new basis.
items.echoBoundary: Echo only admits the newly compiled operation.

items.targetParity: Record macro entries into a named register.
items.currentJedit: Macro recording is not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs parsed intent entries plus bounded raw insert spans.
items.causalOpportunity: Macro entries can retain semantic intent instead of sleeps.
items.echoBoundary: Echo does not know macro registers.

items.targetParity: Replay macros through the production command path.
items.currentJedit: Macro replay is not implemented.
items.proofGap: Planned replay must stop at first obstruction and report applied count.
items.causalOpportunity: Macro replay can emit a receipt-bearing causal script report.
items.echoBoundary: Echo admits each resulting operation through normal ports.

items.targetParity: Set local and global marks.
items.currentJedit: Marks are not parity-complete.
items.proofGap: Planned marks need transformable anchor storage.
items.causalOpportunity: Marks can move through edit receipts with anchor bias.
items.echoBoundary: Echo stores receipts; jedit owns mark anchors.

items.targetParity: Jump to exact mark, mark line, or previous jump.
items.currentJedit: Mark jumps are not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs exact/line jump facts and stale mark posture.
items.causalOpportunity: Jump facts can explain transformed or degraded marks.
items.echoBoundary: Echo is not cursor authority.

items.targetParity: Traverse the jump list backward and forward.
items.currentJedit: Jump list traversal is not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs navigation receipt facts and stack policy.
items.causalOpportunity: Navigation history can be inspectable without text mutation.
items.echoBoundary: Echo receives no edit admission.

items.targetParity: Traverse changes where feasible.
items.currentJedit: Change-list traversal is not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs mapping from edit receipts to cursor-return anchors.
items.causalOpportunity: Change list can be derived from causal edit receipts.
items.echoBoundary: Echo facts are generic receipts; jedit projects editor navigation.

items.targetParity: Record forward and backward search history.
items.currentJedit: Vim search history is not complete.
items.proofGap: Needs pattern parsing, history storage, and match witness facts.
items.causalOpportunity: Search history can cite reading basis and match ids.
items.echoBoundary: Echo does not parse search patterns.

items.targetParity: Repeat searches and search for word under cursor.
items.currentJedit: Repeat and word-under-cursor search are not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs direction, token, and match identity rules.
items.causalOpportunity: Search matches can feed later range commands.
items.echoBoundary: Echo remains generic.

items.targetParity: Substitute within the current or specified range.
items.currentJedit: Substitute command parity is not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs pattern/replacement parsing, flags, and escaping.
items.causalOpportunity: Substitution can emit deterministic range-set facts.
items.echoBoundary: Echo admits final replacement operations only.

items.targetParity: Run file-scope substitute with confirmation flow.
items.currentJedit: File-scope confirmed substitute is not implemented.
items.proofGap: Planned as strand preview with selected admission.
items.causalOpportunity: Each accepted replacement can be a strand slice.
items.echoBoundary: Echo receives only admitted replacements.

items.targetParity: Run commands over matching or non-matching line sets.
items.currentJedit: Global and vglobal are not implemented.
items.proofGap: Planned range-set execution with unsupported nested-command obstruction.
items.causalOpportunity: Global commands can preview a braid of affected ranges.
items.echoBoundary: Echo does not evaluate ex syntax.

items.targetParity: Open a path through command-line completion and dispatch.
items.currentJedit: Command-line edit dispatch and file completion exist.
items.causalOpportunity: Open can seed later workflow witnesses with basis facts.
items.echoBoundary: Echo remains text authority after file material is opened.

items.targetParity: Save, quit, and save-then-quit from the Vim command line.
items.currentJedit: Write, quit, wq, and aliases dispatch through existing workspace flows.
items.causalOpportunity: Save witnesses can cite final materialized text digest.
items.echoBoundary: Filesystem save remains app/adapter policy, not Echo semantics.

items.targetParity: Resolve ex ranges for later commands.
items.currentJedit: General ex range grammar is not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs range parser and resolver over reading basis.
items.causalOpportunity: Range resolution can feed strands and range-set witnesses.
items.echoBoundary: Echo receives only admitted text operations.

items.targetParity: Support substitute, global, and vglobal commands.
items.currentJedit: These ex commands are not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs command parser, range-set executor, confirmation, and obstruction posture.
items.causalOpportunity: Broad edits can be previewed and admitted as causal strands.
items.echoBoundary: Echo does not parse ex commands.

items.targetParity: Expose command help and visible invalid-command feedback.
items.currentJedit: Unknown command feedback exists; full help parity remains open.
items.proofGap: Needs complete help surface after commands stabilize.
items.causalOpportunity: Help can expose proof status from this matrix.
items.echoBoundary: Echo is not involved.

items.targetParity: Handle shell, read-filter, and sort posture honestly.
items.currentJedit: Shell/filter/sort ex commands are not implemented.
items.proofGap: Needs host-boundary policy and deterministic lower modes.
items.causalOpportunity: Host effects should be isolated and reviewable before admission.
items.echoBoundary: Echo never executes shell commands.
